## SignObject

`sign`: what to sign, and what it is.

`did_log_entry`: an identity's next did:webvh log entry, signed with a key
named as a `did:key`. `credential`: a credential an issuer grants a holder,
an SD-JWT VC (`document`: its header, payload and disclosures; see
`registry_api.issuance`), signed as a JWS by the issuer's signer.

| Field | Type | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `kind` | `did_log_entry`, `credential`, `status_list` |  |
| `identity` | string |  |
| `tenant` | string or null |  |
| `did` | string or null |  |
| `version` *(optional)* | integer or null |  |
| `valid_until` *(optional)* | string or null |  |
| `signers` | array of string |  |
| `verification_method` *(optional)* | string or null |  |
| `proof_purpose` *(optional)* | `assertionMethod`, `authentication` | default `"assertionMethod"` |
| `document` | object |  |
| `status_change` *(optional)* | [StatusChange](/reference/api/schemas/#statuschange) or null |  |
